quarterly_data.quarter: Jenoptik press release: Jenoptik raises EBITDA margin guidance (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Guidance raised (release): the Executive Board now expects a FY2026 EBITDA margin of around 22 percent (previously 20 to 21 percent), after the nine-month margin improved to approximately 22 percent (prior year 17.5 percent) on preliminary figures, partly on product mix; revenue growth is still expected between 5 and 9 percent.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 EBITDA margin around 22% (previously 20%-21%); revenue growth 5%-9% unchanged

quarterly_data.quarter: Jenoptik press release: Jenoptik raises EBITDA margin guidance (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary nine months 2026 (release): strong OEM demand, especially from the semiconductor equipment industry, with high order momentum continuing in Q3, in particular in the semiconductor equipment business; group order intake 1.1 billion euros (prior year 777.3 million euros), revenue more than 800 million euros (753.2 million euros) and EBITDA almost 180 million euros (131.8 million euros).
quarterly_data.figure: 9M orders 1.1 billion euros (777.3 million); revenue more than 800 million euros; EBITDA almost 180 million euros
